content: Root cause: The bug was caused by a race condition where the `rpmsg_tty_port` structure was being freed in the `rpmsg_tty_remove` function while it was still being referenced in the `tty_struct`. This situation arose because the release of the `tty_port` was not synchronized, leading to potential use-after-free errors when the `tty_struct` attempted to access the `rpmsg_tty_port` after it had already been freed. The modifications introduced proper reference counting and cleanup mechanisms to ensure that the `rpmsg_tty_port` is only freed after all references to it have been released, thus preventing the race condition.
